issues.description: The solution for Aufgabe 04 uses a column alias 'District' (regierungsbezirk AS District) even though the problem instructions explicitly tell students not to rename columns with AS unless requested. This creates a cross-artifact inconsistency: the problem statement forbids unnecessary aliasing (which the auto-checker may rely on for expected column names), while the provided solution uses an alias. Students could be confused about whether aliases are allowed and the automated checks may expect the original column name.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the unnecessary alias in the solution (use regierungsbezirk instead of regierungsbezirk AS District) so it conforms to the instruction not to rename columns unless requested. Alternatively, if the alias is intentional, update the problem statement to explicitly allow or require that alias so students are not confused.

issues.description: The problem asks for the name of the Regierungsbezirk (German identifier 'regierungsbezirk'), but the solution query renames that column to the English alias 'District' (regierungsbezirk AS District). This introduces an unexpected identifier change between the problem statement and the provided solution, increasing cognitive load and violating the exercise instruction not to rename columns with AS unless requested.
issues.suggestedFix: Use the same identifier as in the problem statement. Remove the alias in the solution and return the column as regierungsbezirk (e.g. SELECT regierungsbezirk, SUM(einwohner_w), SUM(einwohner_m) FROM Gemeinde GROUP BY regierungsbezirk) so students see the exact name referenced in the task.
